[{"insert":"Single Arm DB Row

The single arm dumbbell row works each side independently through a long horizontal pulling range. Brace the non-working hand on a bench or knee and keep the hips square. The 20X1 tempo means pull fast, no pause at the top, then one second lower. Reps descend across the three working sets from 15 to 10 while RPE increases.  Find a weight that challenges you by the final working set.
"}]
